correctness.rationale: Reduction of \(T_\mu\)-period-two orbits to \(g_\mu\) two-cycles is exact; the opposite-sign lemma and sum/product equations prove \(\mu<-1\) is necessary (\(\mu=1\) checked separately). For \(t=-(\mu+1)>0\) the real denominators are strictly positive. A polynomial composition identity yields \(Q_t\), with two roots guaranteed on disjoint negative intervals by explicit sign evaluations; Descartes gives at most two negative roots including multiplicities, making both simple and exhausting every orbit. The inner and outer asymptotic scales follow from perturbation about simple roots of their limiting polynomials, and the first correction of the outer roots is exact. The bundled SymPy checker was successfully executed against its actual script path; it verifies all nonstandard algebra. Numerical root examples were consistency checks only, not proof of the universal theorem.

evidence: Bastien–Rogalski doi:10.1016/j.jmaa.2006.02.095 abstract: additive recurrence with symmetric elliptic quartic \(x^2y^2+dxy(x+y)+c(x^2+y^2)+bxy+a(x+y)=K\).
The quartic Vieta exchange for that symmetric invariant gives \(\psi(s)=-(d s^2+b s+a)/(s^2+c)\), at most quadratic numerator.
For \(\mu<-1\) the present ψ(s)=2\(\mu\)s+4(1−\(\mu\))s²/(1+s²) has nonzero cubic numerator \(2\mu s^3+4(1-\mu)s^2+2\mu s\).

originality.rationale: The exact underlying conservative Gumowski–Mira family, its two-cycle count, and opposite local/infinite threshold scales were compared by implication with accessible primary studies. The original equation in Ambika–Ambika is not a theorem for the zero-dissipation \(\mu<-1\) branch. Later exact Gumovski–Mira results use odd, different rational functions or a different quartic-integrable class: their scalar recurrence right sides cannot match the cubic-numerator \(2g_\mu\) for \(\mu<-1\). The numerical dissipative papers cannot imply the global sharp count. Semantic mathematical-record searches found unrelated period-two systems rather than the specified family. This supports originality with explicit unverified historical-source risk; absence of search hits alone is not used as proof.
residual_risks: Original Gumowski–Mira publications and 1980 monograph were not examined in full text; the exact period-two count or an equivalent reformulation might appear in historical chapters.
The 1985 original-authors article was abstract-only, and the 2007 additive quartic paper was compared by its published model statement rather than all appendices.

value.rationale: The model is the standard rational Gumowski–Mira map restricted to its natural area-preserving subfamily. Complete primitive-period-two orbit counts on every real parameter are mathematically meaningful low-order resonance/bifurcation information; the sharp threshold \(\mu=-1\) has a genuine two-branch global geometry, with one collapse and one escape to infinity on different exponents. Neither branch count nor the unbounded branch is a direct textbook deduction from the map name or simple fixed-point linearization. The exact global count and limiting scales provide precise features to test bifurcation and numerical studies. The result makes no unsupported stability or higher-period claims.
